newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to raise March wholesale product prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to raise March wholesale product prices.

text.p: Major Japanese refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Thursday it would raise its wholesale oil product prices by 700 yen per kilolitre (kl) effective March 1.
Following the change, its gasoline will be priced at 93,200 yen per kl, including tax.
Kerosene and gas oil, neither of which is taxed at the wholesale stage, will be priced at 39,200 yen per kl.
Idemitsu said it decided to raise wholesale prices for March in spite of the decline in world crude oil prices because the cost of importing rose as the yen weakened against the dollar.
Japanese oil companies review their wholesale prices every month to take into account the latest crude oil prices and foreign exchange levels.
Idemitsu, which last month said it had started a review of the pricing system, said on Thursday it had not yet reached a conclusion about whether to change or maintain the current method.
